_note: 英雄立绘 art 数据源（游戏侧概念，非 DDD 战斗面）。prompt 组装口径与技能卡一致：[manifest.artFormat, heroArtStyle, subject, ...elements, mood].filter(Boolean).join(', ')。改风格只改 heroArtStyle 一处。
_keyFormat: hero_s{strength}a{agility}i{intelligence}_{gender}.png —— 与 herogen.ts COMBOS 顺序一致（s 0..3, a 0..3-s, i 3-s-a）。
_designRule: 英雄与职业随机搭配，故画面不出现任何职业特征：无制服、无徽章、无武器、无职业专属道具，只以体型/体态/气质区分力敏智倾向。
heroArtStyle: Victorian-era full-body character illustration in a clean semi-realistic painted trading-card style, smooth digital painterly rendering with crisp detail, no heavy impasto, no visible canvas texture, no thick brushwork, a lived-in atmospheric Victorian setting behind the figure such as a gaslit cobblestone street, a foggy brick alley or a candlelit interior with tall windows, soft depth-of-field background, muted earth-and-ash palette with warm gaslight accents, plain civilian period clothing, no uniform, no insignia, no weapon, no class-specific gear, anatomically correct human figure with exactly two arms and two hands, no extra or deformed limbs
